posts.body:
Wow, can't believe I've made it to 20 weeks so far! Obviously I'm starting to think about what we need now for the little one and since we live in HK, they all have to be incredibly practical. 

One of the things I would like to have though is a jogging stroller for my DH. We live by the water, and he loves running on the boardwalk. I think I would love to encourage him to continue - with baby in tow. For him to bond, for me to get some previous alone time. 

I'm hoping to get just one stroller so wondering if anyone has any experience with using the Mini Jogger strollers in HK? Are they good for running, good for navigating the MTR? Weight? bulk and general usability?

Thanks!
